STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_03839_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_03839_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_03839(
    input reset,
    input clk0,
    input nop,
    input reada,
    input writea,
    input refresh,
    input preacharge,
    input load_mod,
    input [31:0] caddr,
    input [2:0] cas_lat,
    input [2:0] ras_cas,
    input [2:0] ref_dur,
    input page_mod,
    input [2:0] bur_len,
    input ref_req,
    
    output [31:0] sadd,
    output [3:0] cs,
    output ras,
    output cas,
    output we,
    output cke,
    output [2:0] ba,
    output oe,
    output ref_ack,
    output cmack
);

wire do_nop;
wire do_reada;
wire do_writea;
wire do_writea1;
wire do_refresh;
wire do_preacharge;
wire do_load_mod;
wire command_done;
wire [7:0] command_delay;
wire do_act;
wire rw_flag;
wire [3:0] rp_shift;
wire rp_done;
wire [15:0] rowaddr;
wire [10:0] coladdr;
wire [2:0] bankaddr;
wire [2:0] cas_lat;
wire oe4;

assign rowaddr   = caddr[25:10];         
assign coladdr   = caddr[9:0];        
assign bankaddr  = caddr[28:26];    

// Embedded logic for ras_cas_delay
assign do_rw = (ras_cas == 3'b001) ? do_reada : 
               (ras_cas == 3'b010) ? do_writea : 
               1'b0;

// Embedded logic for ref_ack
assign cmack = (do_refresh || do_reada || do_writea || do_preacharge || do_load_mod) && ref_req;
assign ref_ack = cmack;

// Embedded logic for oe_generator
assign oe = (page_mod && do_writea1) ? 1 : 0;

// Embedded logic for cmd_generator
assign sadd = (rw_flag) ? {16{do_reada | do_writea, rowaddr, coladdr, bankaddr}} : 32'b0;
assign ba = bankaddr;
assign cs = (do_load_mod) ? 4'b0010 : (do_preacharge) ? 4'b0001 : 4'b0000;
assign ras = (do_load_mod | do_preacharge) ? ~do_rw : 1'b0;
assign cas = do_rw;
assign we = (do_load_mod | do_preacharge) ? ~do_rw : 1'b0;
assign cke = (do_load_mod) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1;

// Embedded logic for cmd_detector
assign do_nop = nop;
assign do_reada = reada;
assign do_writea = writea;
assign do_writea1 = (writea && !do_reada) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
assign do_refresh = refresh;
assign do_preacharge = preacharge;
assign do_load_mod = load_mod;
assign rw_flag = (do_reada || do_writea) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

endmodule
